text:
sara: Heads-up — preflight prompt-eval raised a regression on the summarizer prompt set. Delta = +5.8% decline in helpfulness score (primary metric). Canaries due in 30m. I want a tactical decision: pin current serving model or let the rollout continue?
sara: logs attached in CI but short summary: skew on long-context examples, hallucination macro-case went up, not just noise.
deploybot: preflight run 2387654321 triggered by PR #4821. Summary: overall pass but prompt-suite subgroup 'summarizer-long' failed threshold. (details: mean helpfulness 0.72 -> 0.68, threshold 0.70)
vivek: thanks, sara. Is this across all regions or only eu-canary?
sara: observed in both eu and us canaries, stronger in eu. latencies normal.
olivia: QA quick check — I sampled the failing prompts: a lot are >3k token context where the model drops coherence. Might be an unintended tokenization/kv-cache alignment after quantization tweak.
kal: if it's kv cache/quant we should avoid full rollback. Option A: pin the previous model version for upcoming canary traffic (preserve rollout but block promotion). Option B: immediate rollback to previous stable worldwide. Which risk tolerance do we want?
maria: product leaning toward minimal user impact. Pinning canary seems fine, but we need owners to approve. Also update release notes to explain temporary pin.
sara: propose: pin the canary route to model: redwood/summarizer-v2.2.7 for next 2 hours, allow runtime team to bisect the quant change. If fix found, we can resume promotion.
qa-bot: approval check: tests required: regression-retest on 200-sample golden set + sanity safety checks. Current run: 1/3 completed.
kal: agree with pin. I will open a bisect job and run focused preflight with quant revert. If revert fixes, we can hotfix and resume.
vivek: +1 from infra to hold the canary pin. Can you add a fallback policy to route 100% of canary traffic to v2.2.7?
sara: done — patched route policy: canary -> v2.2.7. Command used: `deploybot pin-route --route canary --model redwood/summarizer-v2.2.7 --duration 2h`
deploybot: ack: route canary pinned to redwood/summarizer-v2.2.7 until 2027-04-06T15:36:01Z. Notifying release channel.
olivia: QA will run the 200-sample regression now and report within 20m.
maria: thanks all. Please add a line to release notes: "Canary temporarily pinned to v2.2.7 due to prompt-eval regression under long-context prompts; investigating quantization interaction."
kal: starting bisect job now. Will post intermediate results. If bisect isolates commit, we'll prepare a targeted hotfix and a short maintenance window.
sara: if QA passes in 20m, we can keep the pin and avoid customer-facing rollback. If QA fails, escalate to rollback + broader mitigation.
vivek: ping me if we need capacity to repro at scale.
olivia: QA update: 200-sample retest done — pass restored to 0.71 mean helpfulness on pinned v2.2.7, previously failing variant still shows 0.68.
sara: ok — conclusion: pin stands, block promotion, start bisect/patch work. I'll update the release ticket and tag @oncall.
deploybot: ticket updated: REL-1129 set state=held; tag=pin-applied; assigned=sara,kal.
maria: I'll notify partner teams and add note to release notes draft. :white_check_mark:
kal: posting bisect link: https://ci.redwood.internal/bisect/2387654321 — first suspect commit is 7f9c2a (quant kernel tweak).
sara: thanks — keep thread for triage updates. We'll reconvene in 1h or earlier if hotfix emerges. :thumbsup:
